mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.title, c.description, c.instructor_id, u.name AS instructor_name, c.status, c.max_students, c.completion_rate_required, c.created_at FROM course c JOIN users u ON c.instructor_id = u.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.title, c.description, c.instructor_id, u.name AS instructor_name, c.status, c.max_students, c.completion_rate_required, c.created_at FROM course c JOIN users u ON c.instructor_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (tenant_id, title, description, instructor_id, status, max_students, completion_rate_required) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{instructorId}, #{status}, #{maxStudents}, #{completionRateRequired})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, max_students = #{maxStudents}, completion_rate_required = #{completionRateRequired} WHERE id = #{id}
